mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, note_id AS noteId, book_name AS bookName, page_no AS pageNo, context, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user_his_action WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_his_action (user_id, book_id, note_id, book_name, page_no, context, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{noteId}, #{bookName}, #{pageNo}, #{context}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_his_action SET book_id = #{bookId}, note_id = #{noteId}, book_name = #{bookName}, page_no = #{pageNo}, context = #{context}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
